column1: I'm sorry my mad, insane plan\001caused you so much trouble.\003How can I ever repay you for your help?

column1: So^\003^you've gotten past all my safeguards!\003There's only one thing left to do!
column2: 原來^\003^你突破了我所有的防護！\003那就只剩一件事可做了！

column1: I'm arming the self-destruct mechanism.\003Only I know the secret code to stop it!
column2: 我要啟動自毀裝置。\003只有我知道停止的密碼！

column1: There!\003The house will blow up in 2 minutes.\003Heh heh heh!
column2: 好了！\003這棟房子兩分鐘後就會爆炸。\003嘿嘿嘿！

column1: Oh...what happened?\003I feel much better now!\003I'm free of this machine's control!
column2: 喔……發生什麼事了？\003我覺得好多了！\003我脫離這台機器的控制了！

column1: But wait!\003The self-destruct sequence was initated!\003I'll try to turn it off.
column2: 但是等等！\003自毀程序已經啟動了！\003我試著把它關掉。

column1: I can't disable it!\003The meteor must have control of the\001entire system!
column2: 我關不掉！\003那顆隕石一定控制了\001整個系統！

column1: Hey kid!\003You've got to help me!\003We have to get rid of that meteor once\001and for all!
column2: 喂，孩子！\003你得幫我！\003我們必須一次\001徹底解決那顆隕石！

column1: All right, slime-ball! The game's up.
I'll take care of sucker face\001you get the meteor.
column2: 我來對付吸盤臉，\001你去抓隕石。

column1: What are you doing to MY FRIEND!!\003I've warned you, don't mess around\001with my band members!\003NOW GET OUT OF HERE!
column2: 你對我朋友做什麼！！\003我警告過你，不要動\001我樂團的成員！\003馬上給我出去！

column1: A publishing contract for the meteor?\003It'll be happy to see that!\001Sorry I bothered you!\003Move along, move along.
column2: 給隕石的出版合約？\003它看到一定很高興！\001抱歉打擾你了！\003走吧走吧。

column1: You're with the Meteor Police!!\003Dr. Fred made me do it!\001He forced me to go along with his plan!
column2: 你是隕石警察！！\003是佛瑞德博士逼我的！\001他強迫我配合他的計畫！

column1: It's all his fault, I'm innocent!\003He's right in there^\003^get him ^ arrest him ^ kill him.
column2: 全都是他的錯，我是無辜的！\003他就在那裡面^\003^抓他 ^ 逮捕他 ^ 殺了他。

column1: He's mad ^ I'll help you.\003I'm your friend, you can trust me.
column2: 他瘋了 ^ 我會幫你。\003我是你的朋友，你可以信任我。

column1: Daddy's been acting very strangely ever\001since his secret project in the lab^
column2: 自從爸爸在實驗室搞那個秘密計畫，\001他就一直很奇怪^

column1: Well, Mommy, I'm worried about him.\003He hasn't been at dinner for 5 years^
column2: 媽，我很擔心他。\003他已經五年沒來吃晚餐了^

column1: ^and he's been bringing those bodies\001down into the basement late at night.
column2: ^而且他半夜一直把那些屍體\001搬進地下室。

column1: WHAT'S YOUR POINT ED?!\003I'M A VERY BUSY LADY!
column2: 你到底想說什麼，愛德？！\003我可是很忙的！

column1: Edna^\003I'm having trouble with the Zom-B-Matic.\003I need to shut down the power.\003It'll be off for 5 or 6 minutes.
column2: 愛德娜^\003殭屍自動機出了問題。\003我得把電源關掉，\003大概要斷電五、六分鐘。

column1: Is this all you have to say to me?\003You've been in the basement for\001the past 5 years?\003Sometimes I think you like that meteor\001more than me!
column2: 你就只有這句話要跟我說嗎？\003你這五年都待在地下室？\003有時候我覺得你愛那顆隕石\001勝過愛我！

column1: Don't worry my little Beauty Queen\001soon everything will be different.
column2: 別擔心，我的小美后，\001一切很快就會不一樣了。

column1: Hey Ed!\003The meteor wants to borrow\001your hamster and electric cattle prod.
column2: 喂，愛德！\003隕石想借你的倉鼠\001和電牛棒。

column1: My hamster!! NOBODY touches my HAMSTER!
column2: 我的倉鼠！！誰都不准碰我的倉鼠！

column1: Better watch it, Ed\001you're going to piss-off the meteor.\003It already thinks you stole\001my purple card key.
column2: 你小心一點，愛德，\001你會把隕石惹火。\003它已經認為是你偷了\001我的紫色卡片鑰匙。

column1: Er^\003I don't know what you're talking about!
column2: 呃^\003我不知道你在說什麼！

column1: I can't get to the meteor without it.
column2: 沒有它我到不了隕石那裡。

column1: Hi all you budding writers, musicians,\001and game designers!\003I'm Mark Eteer and my company will\001publish ANYTHING!\003Just mail it to the address shown below.
column2: 各位有志的作家、音樂家\001和遊戲設計師好！\003我是馬克・伊帝爾，我的公司\001什麼都出版！\003只要寄到下面這個地址就行。

column1: Wow!\003This is hot stuff!\003It will sell millions maybe\001even BILLIONS!!\003I'm going to make Mr. Meteor a\001million dollar offer!
column2: 哇！\003這東西太搶手了！\003會賣掉幾百萬本，\001說不定幾十億本！！\003我要給隕石先生開\001一百萬的價！

column1: What is this garbage!\003I wouldn't even use it to start a fire.
column2: 這什麼垃圾！\003拿來生火我都嫌。

column1: A cassette tape!\003Now, where's the play button?
column2: 一卷錄音帶！\003播放鍵在哪裡？

column1: A blank tape? Is this a joke?
column2: 空白帶？這是在開玩笑嗎？

column1: I like the beat, but the melody stinks!
column2: 節奏我喜歡，但旋律爛透了！

column1: Wonderful!\003Outrageous!\003AWESOME!!\003This will be a MEGAHIT!\003I've got to sign them right now!
column2: 太精彩了！\003太狂了！\003太讚了！！\003這會是超級熱門！\003我得馬上簽下他們！

column1: Welcome back from our break.\003We've been talking with the celebrity^\003^rock who gave up a life of crime for\001a career as a writer.
column2: 廣告後歡迎回來。\003我們正在訪問這位名人^\003^這顆放棄犯罪生涯、\001改行當作家的石頭。

column1: So, Mr. Meteor, how does it feel\001to be famous instead of infamous?
column2: 隕石先生，從惡名昭彰變成\001鼎鼎大名，感覺如何？

column1: Well, Wink, it feels great.\001But, I couldn't have done it alone^
column2: 溫克，感覺很棒。\001不過我不是一個人辦到的^

column1: I don't care if you've reformed\001you're still coming with me!
column2: 我不管你改不改過，\001你還是得跟我走！
警告！！\003擅入者將被殘忍肢解。
